draftsBrowserOnly: Unsent decision drafts stay in this browser and are never sent automatically.
intro: Sign in to see what needs you and to answer decisions.
signOutConfirmTitle: Sign out of this Hub session?
signOutCookieScope: It does not revoke issued tokens or sign you out of Cloudflare Access. If Cloudflare Access is active, it will continue to identify you in this app.
signOutDescription: This clears Hub cookies in this browser.
signOutDraftNotice: Review unsaved settings before continuing. Nothing in a retained draft will be sent automatically.
signOutSuccess: Hub session cookies were cleared. Cloudflare Access and issued tokens are separate.
signOutUnconfirmed: The Hub session could not be confirmed as cleared. Check the session before trying again.
title: Sign in
unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again.
readOnlyBrowse: You can still browse Updates and Delivery without signing in. Answering decisions and changing personal settings requires an owner session.
secureRequired: Password verification requires a secure connection. Open the Hub over HTTPS or from localhost on this machine.
enrollmentIntro: Connect your existing authenticator account to the owner signed in through Cloudflare Access.
enrollmentError: Could not confirm the connection. Check your credentials and try again.
revokeDescription: This removes every authenticator account connected to your Cloudflare Access owner identity.
revokeError: Could not confirm that accounts were disconnected. Try again.
